name: Impeccable setup guide
description: Impeccable, the free design skill from the reel: 24 commands that make Claude's websites bolder, fix the fonts and colour, review the page like a designer, and catch what makes a site look AI-made.

page.title: Make Claude design your website like a pro
page.sub: The free design skill from the reel. It gives Claude 24 design commands and checks every page against 62 rules for what makes a site look AI-made, so yours doesn't.
page.prompt_how: Run this one command in a terminal, inside your website's folder. Then reload Claude Code and type the command under it.
page.prompt_note: No Claude Code? Scroll down for a plain prompt that works in any Claude chat.
page.tested_title: We checked it against its own page

results.name: The before and after in the reel are the project's own
Running it on a real website ourselves

page.tested_text: We read the project's own page: **over 100,000 stars**, Apache licence, **24 commands** and **62 rules** that flag the usual tells (the same font on everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards inside cards). The two website pictures in the reel are the project's own: the same model and the same brief, without the skill and with it. It says itself that it is **strongest on a page that already exists**. **Not checked by us:** running it on a real website.
page.tip: **The tip:** point it at one part of the page, not the whole site. "/impeccable critique the pricing section" gets a much better answer than "fix my website".

prompt:
npx impeccable install

Then, in Claude Code:
/impeccable init

followups.label: No Claude Code? Try this first
followups.prompt: Act as a senior web designer reviewing my page. Here it is: [paste a screenshot or the link]. Tell me the three things that make it look generic or AI-made (for example: the same font everywhere, a purple-to-blue gradient, cards inside cards, grey text on a coloured background), ranked by what to fix first. For each one, tell me exactly what to change, in plain words I can hand to whoever builds the site.
followups.note: This is our own prompt. It works in any Claude chat, with nothing to install.

followups.label: Review it, then make it bolder
followups.prompt:
/impeccable critique the homepage

Then: /impeccable bolder the hero section
followups.note: The review ranks what to fix first. Bolder is for a page that looks safe and forgettable.

followups.label: Fonts, colour, then the last pass
followups.prompt:
/impeccable typeset the homepage
/impeccable colorize the homepage
/impeccable polish the homepage
followups.note: Run them one at a time and look at the page after each.

checklist_title: Set it up in five steps

checklist.title: Have Claude Code and a website project
checklist.detail: The claude command in a terminal (or the Code tab in the Claude desktop app), on a paid Claude plan, opened in the folder that holds your site. The install command needs Node, which is free.

checklist.title: Run the one command
checklist.detail: It finds Claude Code and installs the skill. When it offers the design check (the "hook"), say yes: that is the part that catches problems before you see them.

checklist.title: Reload, then type /impeccable init
checklist.detail: It reads your site and asks a few questions about who it's for. Every later command uses those answers.

checklist.title: Name a command and a target
checklist.detail: For example: /impeccable critique the homepage. One section at a time works best.

checklist.title: Look before it goes live
checklist.detail: Open the page on your phone and check every price, name and claim yourself.

safety: **It works best on a page you already have.** Get a first version built, then polish it.
**It improves the look, not the facts.** Read every page before it goes live and check prices, names and claims.
**Only run it on a website you own or work on.**
**We have not run it on a real website ourselves yet.** Everything here is from the project's own page.
